// Supplies' home page: the most liked public lists.

view():

    <Section title="Popular lists">

files./supplies/List.view:
// One list: its curators, a like button, and its practices with this list's tags.
use "data/schema.usl"
use "parts/cards.view"
use "actions.view"

view(id):
  <Shell title={l.name}
    for={l in List} where={l.id == id}
    fallback={<Shell title="List unavailable" />}>

    <Row slot="subtitle">
      <Text style="secondary">a list by</Text>
      <Avatar person={l.owner} />
      <Avatar person={c}
        for={c in l.contributors.person} where={c != l.owner}
        orderBy={c.name} />
    </Row>

    <Button slot="actions" action={toggleListReaction(l: l)}
      where={l.visibility == "Public", me != null}>
      👍 {count(l.reactions)}
    </Button>

    <Markdown source={l.about} />

    <Grid columns={3}>
      <Column for={i in l.items}>
        <PracticeCard p={i.practice} />
        <Row>
          <Badge color={t.color} for={t in i.practice.tags} where={t.list == l}>{t.name}</Badge>
        </Row>
      </Column>
    </Grid>
  </Shell>
files./supplies/Practices.view:
// Search and sort practices. The search text is state, so it never leaves the device:
// the host returns every practice and the client filters them.
use "data/schema.usl"
use "parts/cards.view"

view():
  state q = ""
  keep sortBy = "name"

  <Shell title="Practices">
    <Row slot="actions">
      <TextField value={q} placeholder="Search" />
      <Button action={set(sortBy, "name")} selected={sortBy == "name"}>A–Z</Button>
      <Button action={set(sortBy, "authors")} selected={sortBy == "authors"}>Most authors</Button>
    </Row>
    <Grid columns={3}>
      <PracticeCard p={p}
        for={p in Practice} where={q == "" or q in p.name}
        orderBy={sortBy == "name" ? p.name : count(p.authors) desc}
        fallback={<Text style="secondary">No practices match “{q}”.</Text>} />
    </Grid>
  </Shell>
files./supplies/Profile.view:
// A person's page. Who may see a list is the List model's read rule, which the host
// applies to every read, so views don't repeat it.
use "data/schema.usl"
use "parts/cards.view"

curatedBy(l, person): l.owner == person or person in l.contributors.person

view(id):
  <Shell title={person.name} subtitle="@{person.handle}"
    for={person in Person} where={person.id == id}
    fallback={<Shell title="Profile not found" />}>

    <Section title="Practices">
      <Grid columns={3}>
        <PracticeCard p={p}
          for={p in Practice} where={person in p.authors}
          orderBy={p.name} />
      </Grid>
    </Section>

    <Section title="Lists featuring their practices">
      <Grid columns={2}>
        <ListCard list={l} for={l in List} where={person in l.items.practice.authors} />
      </Grid>
    </Section>

    <Section title="Lists they curate">
      <Grid columns={2}>
        <ListCard list={l}
          for={l in List} where={curatedBy(l, person)}
          orderBy={l.name} />
      </Grid>
    </Section>

    <Section title="Collaborators">
      <Row>
        <Avatar person={other}
          for={p in Practice, other in p.authors} where={person in p.authors, other != person}
          orderBy={other.name} />
      </Row>
    </Section>

    <Section title="Who wrote what with them">
      <Text for={p in Practice, other in p.authors} where={person in p.authors, other != person}>
        {other.name} on {p.name}
      </Text>
    </Section>
  </Shell>

// Views drawn as elements by the pages above.
use "../data/schema.usl"

view ListCard(list: List):
  <Card>
    <Row>
      <Link style="heading" to="List?id={list.id}">{list.name}</Link>
      <Text style="secondary">{count(list.items)} practices</Text>
    </Row>
    <Markdown source={list.about} />
    <Row>
      <Avatar person={list.owner} />
      <Text>👍 {count(list.reactions)}</Text>
    </Row>
  </Card>

view PracticeCard(p: Practice):
  <Card>
    <Link style="heading" to="Practice?id={p.id}">{p.name}</Link>
    <Row>
      <Text style="secondary">by</Text>
      <Avatar person={a} for={a in p.authors} orderBy={a.name} />
    </Row>
    <Markdown source={p.about} lines={6} />
  </Card>

view Avatar(person: Person):
  <Link to="Profile?id={person.id}">
    <Portrait src={person.portrait} name={person.name} />
    {person.name}
  </Link>
